MOD = 998244353

def main():
    n = int(input())
    p = list(map(lambda x: int(x) - 1, input().split()))
    s = list(input())
    
    def count_valid_configurations(s, p, n, MOD):
        valid_configurations = 1
        for i in range(n):
            if s[i] == '?':
                valid_configurations *= 2
                valid_configurations %= MOD
        return valid_configurations
    
    valid_configurations = count_valid_configurations(s, p, n, MOD)
    
    print(valid_configurations)
